cross_section.target: y_k = Vov_BTC(k) - Vov_ETH(k) with Vov_i(k) = sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)), v_j = r_j^2, r_j = log(close_j/close_{j-1}) over next H perp bars (forward relative vol-of-vol spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term ratio from the real Deribit option trade tape (EVAL-74 ``_term_bars``): near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_ratio = IV(near expiry) / IV(far expiry) - 1; the term_ratio field is overlaid by bar_open_ms onto EVAL-77's common aligned cross-section; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative vol-of-vol = per underlying vol-of-vol sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)) with v_j = r_j^2 (squared log returns) over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-84/90 verbatim), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH term-ratio-richness predicts BTC subsequently carries the richer forward vol-of-vol — relative turbulence)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative vol-of-vol spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH floors satisfied, at least one config (term_ratio basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
